topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Neighbor Tom come by earlier, wanting to put up a fence 'tween our plots. I told him the wheat hasn’t cared much for fences, spreadin’ where it will, but that wasn’t the truth of it. Fact is, I thought of the fawns that graze at the edge of the field, and the foxes whose paths cross through here, and how this land, before it was ours, belonged to them. A fence... it seemed a harsh thing, like borrowin’ more coin we couldn’t pay back. I nodded, said I’d think on it, but my heart's been heavy ever since, seein' the land through Tom’s eyes, dividin' what’s been whole.
